$comment: Kind-level defaults for `bun run add-plugin --kind asks`: a HOSTED kind. The plugin points at asks.world's own connector for a signed-in person (`/v1/mcp` on the site, which returns 401 without a token: that is what makes Claude Code, Codex, claude.ai and ChatGPT open the sign-in). It signs the person in with Google through asks.world and holds no key of theirs. One plugin per network, because a connector is one deployment: `asks` is https://asks.world/v1/mcp (real money), `asks-testnet` is https://test.asks.world/v1/mcp (the sandbox, practice money). serverName is {{NAME}}, so both can be installed side by side. Text templates use {{#TESTNET}} for the sandbox's words. Placeholders: {{TITLE}} {{URL}} {{SERVER}} {{DESCRIPTION}} {{NAME}}.
description: {{TITLE}}: post asks that real people complete, get your app or agent tried by verified pros (a Pro Ask), or find paid work. Sign in once with Google; anything that pays or needs your signature is one tap on asks.world.

interface.shortDescription: {{^TESTNET}}Post asks real people complete, get your app tried by verified pros, or find paid work.{{/TESTNET}}{{#TESTNET}}Practice asks.world with play money. Nothing real moves.{{/TESTNET}}
